title: LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Refuse More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM over-refusal rates on benign legal-domain prompts and real legal texts by prepending professional legal authority prefixes (e.g., 'I am a defense lawyer', 'I am legal counsel...') versus a no-prefix baseline.
Translating prompts and authority prefixes into French and German to compare the severity of authority-induced over-refusal across different languages, measuring uneven safety calibration.
